questions.question: Explain image sampling and quatization.
questions.solution_html: • Explain image sampling and quantization. / Image sampling (1 mark) : Sampling converts the continuous spatial coordinates of an image into a finite set of discrete pixel locations. Image quantization (1 mark) : Quantization converts the continuous intensity values of the sampled image into a finite number of discrete intensity or gray levels.
